FungalInfection.Description: FungalInfection is fungal infection of skin nails due to dermatophytes candida causing itching rash circular patches. CAUSES: Fungal infection due to moisture sweating poor hygiene contact
FungalInfection.Symptoms: 1. Red circular itchy patches ring shaped 2. Intense itching worse at night sweating 3. Dry scaly flaking skin 4. Burning sensation 5. Blisters small fluid filled 6. Oozing yellow crust 7. Dark pigmentation after healing 8. Thickened skin 9. Hair loss over patch 10. Scarring 11. Bleeding on scratching 12. Secondary bacterial infection
FungalInfection.Precautions: For FungalInfection: Keep skin dry clean, avoid sharing towels clothes, wear cotton loose, antifungal powder, no scratching, wash clothes in hot water
FungalInfection.Diet: Diet for FungalInfection: Include probiotic curd garlic turmeric fruits vegetables, avoid sugar excessive sweets alcohol, drink 2-3L water, include neem
FungalInfection.Exercise: Exercise for FungalInfection: Keep hygiene during exercise, 20-30 min walk yoga, avoid gym sharing mats until cured, maintain BMI
FungalInfection.Lab_Tests: For FungalInfection: KOH mount scraping positive fungus, Fungal Culture, CBC, Skin biopsy if needed

Boils.Description: Boils are painful pus-filled bacterial infection of hair follicle by Staphylococcus aureus causing red swollen lump. CAUSES: Bacteria Staphylococcus aureus poor hygiene diabetes low immunity friction
Boils.Symptoms: 1. Red painful swollen lump >1cm 2. Pus filled yellow center 3. Pain throbbing increasing 4. Fever low grade 5. Swelling around 6. Itching before pus 7. Fatigue 8. Lymph node swelling nearby 9. Multiple boils carbuncle 10. Scarring after healing 11. Warmth over lesion 12. Bleeding on rupture
Boils.Precautions: For Boils: Do not squeeze pop boil, keep clean with antiseptic, warm compress 3x day, maintain hygiene, control diabetes, no sharing towels
Boils.Diet: Diet for Boils: Include fruits vegetables whole grains lean protein vitamin A C E, avoid oily spicy sugar, drink 2-3L water, include turmeric garlic
Boils.Exercise: Exercise for Boils: Avoid gym swimming until healed, 20 min walk, no friction over boil, maintain hygiene
Boils.Lab_Tests: For Boils: Pus Culture Staphylococcus, CBC WBC high, Blood sugar HbA1c diabetes, CRP

Warts.Description: Warts are small rough hard growths on skin due to HPV human papilloma virus infection of keratinocytes. CAUSES: HPV virus contact direct indirect, low immunity cut abrasion
Warts.Symptoms: 1. Small rough grainy bump skin colored 2. Black dots clotted vessels 3. Pain on pressure if plantar wart 4. Multiple warts cluster 5. Itching mild 6. Bleeding on scratching 7. Hard thickened skin 8. On hands fingers feet face 9. Slow growth months 10. No pus 11. Contagious on scratching 12. Recurrence after removal
Warts.Precautions: For Warts: Do not pick scratch wart spreads, avoid direct contact, keep hands clean, no sharing nail cutter towels, boost immunity, HPV vaccine
Warts.Diet: Diet for Warts: Include vitamin A C E zinc foods citrus fruits green leafy nuts seeds, avoid junk, 2-3L water, include garlic
Warts.Exercise: Exercise for Warts: Regular walk yoga boosts immunity, avoid touching warts during gym, keep feet dry for plantar warts
Warts.Lab_Tests: For Warts: Clinical diagnosis visual, Skin biopsy if atypical, HPV DNA test if needed

SkinAllergy.Description: SkinAllergy is immune reaction to allergen causing red itchy rash hives due to histamine release mast cells. CAUSES: Allergy to food dust pollen drugs cosmetics nickel latex insect bite
SkinAllergy.Symptoms: 1. Red rash patches with inflammation 2. Intense itching worse at night 3. Hives wheals raised edematous 4. Burning stinging 5. Blisters small fluid filled 6. Swelling edema around eyes lips 7. Dry scaly skin 8. Oozing pus if infected 9. Pain on scratching 10. Sneezing nasal allergy with skin 11. Dark pigmentation post inflammatory 12. Recurrence on exposure
SkinAllergy.Precautions: For SkinAllergy: Identify avoid allergen trigger, no scratching, use hypoallergenic soap cosmetics, wear cotton, antihistamine as prescribed, patch test
SkinAllergy.Diet: Diet for SkinAllergy: Avoid allergen foods nuts shellfish egg milk if allergic, include fresh fruits vegetables, avoid processed packaged spicy, 2-3L water, probiotic curd
SkinAllergy.Exercise: Exercise for SkinAllergy: 20-30 min walk yoga meditation reduces stress allergy, avoid sweating dust during active rash, shower after exercise
SkinAllergy.Lab_Tests: For SkinAllergy: CBC eosinophils high, IgE Total high, Allergy Patch Test, Skin Prick Test, Allergen Specific IgE

Hyperpigmentation.Description: Hyperpigmentation is darkening of skin due to excess melanin production melanocytes due to sun inflammation hormones. CAUSES: Sun exposure melasma post inflammatory acne hormonal PCOS drug
Hyperpigmentation.Symptoms: 1. Dark brown black patches on face neck hands 2. Uneven skin tone 3. Melasma butterfly on cheeks forehead 4. Post acne dark spots 5. No itching usually 6. Sun worsens darkening 7. Slow increase months years 8. Symmetrical patches both sides 9. No pain 10. Cosmetic concern 11. No bleeding 12. No scaling
Hyperpigmentation.Precautions: For Hyperpigmentation: Use sunscreen SPF 50 daily even indoors, avoid sun 10am-4pm, no picking acne, use hat scarf, avoid harsh bleaching creams
Hyperpigmentation.Diet: Diet for Hyperpigmentation: Include vitamin C orange lemon kiwi vitamin E almonds, avoid excessive sun sensitive foods, drink 2-3L water, include tomato licorice
Hyperpigmentation.Exercise: Exercise for Hyperpigmentation: Indoor exercise avoids sun, 30 min walk yoga, maintain healthy weight PCOS control helps
Hyperpigmentation.Lab_Tests: For Hyperpigmentation: Clinical diagnosis, Wood's lamp exam, Thyroid PCOS hormonal tests if needed, Skin biopsy if atypical

DrySkinDisease.Description: DrySkinDisease is ichthyosis xerosis due to loss of skin barrier oil water causing flaking cracking. CAUSES: Winter cold low humidity hot bath soap harsh aging thyroid deficiency
DrySkinDisease.Symptoms: 1. Dry scaly flaking skin white scales 2. Intense itching worse in winter 3. Cracks fissures painful bleeding 4. Rough tight feeling after bath 5. Redness inflammation 6. Burning stinging 7. Thickened rough skin elbows knees 8. Fine lines wrinkled look 9. Bleeding on scratching 10. Secondary infection 11. Palms soles dry cracked 12. No oiliness
DrySkinDisease.Precautions: For DrySkinDisease: Moisturize immediately after bath within 3 min, avoid hot water long bath, use gentle soap dove, humidifier in winter, drink plenty water, no scratching
DrySkinDisease.Diet: Diet for DrySkinDisease: Include omega 3 fish flaxseed walnuts ghee olive oil, fruits vegetables vitamin A E, drink 3L water, avoid alcohol caffeine dehydrating
DrySkinDisease.Exercise: Exercise for DrySkinDisease: Avoid excessive sweating which dries, 20 min walk yoga, moisturize before after exercise, cotton clothes
DrySkinDisease.Lab_Tests: For DrySkinDisease: Clinical diagnosis, Thyroid TSH, Vitamin A D E levels, Kidney LFT if severe, Skin hydration test

Tonsillitis.Description: Tonsillitis is inflammation infection of tonsils palatine due to virus bacteria streptococcus causing sore throat fever. CAUSES: Virus bacteria Streptococcus pyogenes cold exposure low immunity
Tonsillitis.Symptoms: 1. Severe sore throat pain swallowing 2. Red swollen tonsils with white pus spots 3. High fever 101-103F 4. Headache 5. Ear pain referred 6. Swollen neck lymph nodes painful 7. Loss appetite 8. Hoarseness voice change 9. Bad breath halitosis 10. Headache 11. Vomiting in children 12. Fatigue
Tonsillitis.Precautions: For Tonsillitis: Gargle warm salt water 3x day, avoid cold drinks ice cream, maintain oral hygiene, no smoking, complete antibiotic course if bacterial, rest voice
Tonsillitis.Diet: Diet for Tonsillitis: Warm soft foods dal khichdi soups turmeric milk honey ginger tulsi tea, avoid spicy oily cold, drink 2-3L warm water, include vitamin C
Tonsillitis.Exercise: Exercise for Tonsillitis: Rest during acute infection fever, no exertion until fever 3 days free, light walk after recovery, breathing exercises
Tonsillitis.Lab_Tests: For Tonsillitis: Throat Swab Culture Streptococcus, Rapid Strep Antigen Test, CBC WBC high neutrophils, CRP high, ASO titre if recurrent

Pharyngitis.Description: Pharyngitis is inflammation of pharynx throat due to virus bacteria causing sore throat. CAUSES: Virus flu cold bacteria streptococcus smoking allergy post nasal drip
Pharyngitis.Symptoms: 1. Sore throat scratchy burning 2. Pain on swallowing 3. Red inflamed pharynx 4. Low fever 100-101F 5. Cough dry 6. Hoarseness 7. Runny nose cold symptoms 8. Swollen neck nodes 9. Headache 10. Fatigue 11. Bad breath 12. Ear pain mild
Pharyngitis.Precautions: For Pharyngitis: Warm salt gargle, avoid cold smoke dust, steam inhalation, rest, no shouting, maintain hygiene, mask if viral
Pharyngitis.Diet: Diet for Pharyngitis: Warm fluids turmeric milk honey ginger tea soups khichdi, avoid cold spicy oily, 2-3L warm water, vitamin C fruits
Pharyngitis.Exercise: Exercise for Pharyngitis: Rest during fever sore throat, no strenuous, light walk after 3 days fever free, pranayama after recovery
Pharyngitis.Lab_Tests: For Pharyngitis: Throat swab culture, CBC, CRP, Rapid Strep Test to differentiate

Laryngitis.Description: Laryngitis is inflammation of larynx voice box vocal cords due to virus overuse causing hoarseness loss voice. CAUSES: Virus overuse shouting smoking allergy acid reflux GERD
Laryngitis.Symptoms: 1. Hoarseness loss of voice aphonia 2. Throat pain dry scratchy 3. Dry cough irritating 4. Constant urge to clear throat 5. Low fever 6. Difficulty speaking 7. Swollen vocal cords 8. Fatigue after talking 9. Sore throat mild 10. Breathing difficulty if severe swelling 11. Bad breath 12. Ear pain referred
Laryngitis.Precautions: For Laryngitis: Complete voice rest no whispering shouting, steam inhalation, avoid smoking alcohol, no cold drinks, treat acid reflux, humidify air
Laryngitis.Diet: Diet for Laryngitis: Warm water honey ginger tulsi tea, soft non-spicy foods, avoid cold fried spicy acidic tomato citrus which irritates, 2-3L warm fluids
Laryngitis.Exercise: Exercise for Laryngitis: No exercise during acute loss voice, rest, no shouting during exercise, breathing exercises after recovery
Laryngitis.Lab_Tests: For Laryngitis: Laryngoscopy vocal cords red swollen, Throat swab, CBC, GERD evaluation if recurrent

ThroatInfection.Description: ThroatInfection is bacterial viral infection of throat pharynx tonsils causing sore throat fever difficulty swallowing. CAUSES: Virus bacteria Streptococcus low immunity cold exposure
ThroatInfection.Symptoms: 1. Severe sore throat pain 2. Pain on swallowing solids liquids 3. Red swollen throat tonsils with pus 4. Fever 101-102F 5. Headache 6. Neck lymph nodes swollen tender 7. Ear pain 8. Hoarseness 9. Cough 10. Loss appetite 11. Bad breath 12. Fatigue weakness
ThroatInfection.Precautions: For ThroatInfection: Warm salt water gargle 3-4x day, avoid cold drinks ice cream smoking, maintain oral hygiene, complete antibiotics course, rest, isolation if contagious
ThroatInfection.Diet: Diet for ThroatInfection: Warm soft diet khichdi dal soups turmeric milk honey ginger tea, avoid spicy oily cold, 2-3L warm water, vitamin C orange amla
ThroatInfection.Exercise: Exercise for ThroatInfection: Bed rest during fever, no exertion, light walk after fever 3 days free, breathing exercises later
ThroatInfection.Lab_Tests: For ThroatInfection: Throat Swab Culture, Rapid Strep Test, CBC WBC high, CRP ESR high

StrepThroat.Description: StrepThroat is bacterial throat infection by Group A Streptococcus pyogenes causing severe sore throat fever with pus on tonsils highly contagious. CAUSES: Streptococcus pyogenes bacteria droplet infection low immunity
StrepThroat.Symptoms: 1. Sudden severe sore throat pain swallowing 2. High fever 102-104F 3. Red swollen tonsils with white pus streaks 4. Swollen painful neck lymph nodes 5. Headache 6. Rash scarlet fever sandpaper 7. Abdominal pain in children 8. Nausea vomiting 9. Loss appetite 10. Bad breath 11. Ear pain 12. Fatigue
StrepThroat.Precautions: For StrepThroat: Complete antibiotic course Penicillin 10 days, no self stop even if better, isolate 24 hrs after antibiotics, no sharing utensils, warm salt gargle, rest
StrepThroat.Diet: Diet for StrepThroat: Warm soft foods khichdi dal soups turmeric milk honey, avoid cold spicy oily, 2-3L warm water, vitamin C
StrepThroat.Exercise: Exercise for StrepThroat: Absolute rest during fever, no school work, no exertion until fever 3 days free and antibiotics 2 days, light walk after
StrepThroat.Lab_Tests: For StrepThroat: Rapid Strep Antigen Test positive, Throat Swab Culture gold standard, CBC WBC high neutrophils, ASO titre high after 2 weeks, CRP high

Adenoids.Description: Adenoids is enlargement infection of adenoids nasopharyngeal lymphoid tissue in children causing nasal block snoring mouth breathing. CAUSES: Recurrent infection allergy in children 3-10 years
Adenoids.Symptoms: 1. Nasal block mouth breathing 2. Snoring loud during sleep 3. Nasal voice toneless 4. Recurrent ear infection hearing loss 5. Runny nose persistent 6. Sore throat recurrent 7. Cough night 8. Bad breath 9. Swallowing difficulty 10. Sleep apnea pauses 11. Fatigue day time sleepiness 12. Poor school performance
Adenoids.Precautions: For Adenoids: Treat nasal allergy infection early, steam inhalation, avoid cold dust, nasal saline drops, consult ENT for surgery if grade 3-4
Adenoids.Diet: Diet for Adenoids: Warm fluids, avoid cold ice cream which worsens, include fruits vegetables vitamin C, 2L water, no spicy oily
Adenoids.Exercise: Exercise for Adenoids: Breathing exercises pranayama, no exertion during infection, outdoor play but avoid dust cold
Adenoids.Lab_Tests: For Adenoids: Nasal Endoscopy enlarged adenoids grade, X-Ray nasopharynx soft tissue lateral view, Audiometry hearing loss, Sleep study if apnea

Sinusitis.Description: Sinusitis is inflammation infection of sinuses maxillary frontal ethmoid sphenoid due to virus bacteria allergy blocking ostia. CAUSES: Virus cold bacteria allergy nasal polyp deviated septum
Sinusitis.Symptoms: 1. Facial pain pressure over cheeks forehead eyes worse bending 2. Nasal block congestion 3. Thick yellow green nasal discharge purulent 4. Headache frontal 5. Low fever 100-101F 6. Loss smell anosmia 7. Cough post nasal drip 8. Toothache upper teeth 9. Bad breath 10. Fatigue 11. Ear pressure fullness 12. Sore throat post nasal drip
Sinusitis.Precautions: For Sinusitis: Steam inhalation 2x day, nasal saline irrigation, avoid cold dust smoke allergy triggers, treat cold early, no swimming during acute, head elevated sleep
Sinusitis.Diet: Diet for Sinusitis: Warm fluids turmeric milk honey ginger tulsi tea soups, avoid cold dairy banana which increases mucus in some, include vitamin C spicy soups help drain, 2-3L water
Sinusitis.Exercise: Exercise for Sinusitis: Avoid exertion during acute fever, light walk yoga, breathing exercises anulom vilom helps drainage, no diving swimming until cured
Sinusitis.Lab_Tests: For Sinusitis: X-Ray PNS Waters view haziness, CT PNS gold standard blocked sinuses, Nasal endoscopy, CBC WBC high, Allergy test if recurrent

AllergicRhinitis.Description: AllergicRhinitis is allergic inflammation of nose due to dust pollen mites pet dander causing sneezing runny nose itching. CAUSES: Allergy IgE mediated dust mites pollen animal dander mould
AllergicRhinitis.Symptoms: 1. Sneezing paroxysms 10-20 at a time 2. Runny nose clear watery 3. Nasal block congestion 4. Itching nose eyes palate throat 5. Red watery eyes allergic conjunctivitis 6. Post nasal drip cough 7. Loss smell 8. Headache 9. Fatigue 10. Dark circles allergic shiners 11. Nasal crease salute 12. Recurrence seasonal perennial
AllergicRhinitis.Precautions: For AllergicRhinitis: Avoid dust mites use bed covers wash in hot water, no carpets curtains, avoid pollen morning 5-10am close windows, no pets in bedroom, mask while cleaning, nasal saline wash
AllergicRhinitis.Diet: Diet for AllergicRhinitis: Avoid cold curd banana in night if worsens, include vitamin C citrus honey ginger turmeric, 2-3L water, include probiotic curd, avoid processed foods
AllergicRhinitis.Exercise: Exercise for AllergicRhinitis: Regular walk yoga pranayama improves immunity, indoor exercise during pollen season, no outdoor morning walk in high pollen, breathing exercises
AllergicRhinitis.Lab_Tests: For AllergicRhinitis: CBC eosinophils high, IgE Total high, AEC high, Allergy Skin Prick Test, Nasal smear eosinophils

NasalPolyp.Description: NasalPolyp is soft painless noncancerous growth of nasal mucosa due to chronic inflammation allergy asthma. CAUSES: Chronic sinusitis allergy asthma aspirin sensitivity cystic fibrosis
NasalPolyp.Symptoms: 1. Nasal block progressive bilateral 2. Loss smell anosmia complete 3. Runny nose watery mucus 4. Post nasal drip 5. Snoring mouth breathing 6. Facial pressure pain 7. No pain in polyp itself painless 8. Headache 9. Itching nose 10. Recurrent sinus infection 11. Nosebleed occasional 12. Double vision if large ethmoid
NasalPolyp.Precautions: For NasalPolyp: Treat allergy sinusitis early, avoid aspirin if sensitive, nasal steroid spray as prescribed regular, no nose picking, steam inhalation, follow-up ENT
NasalPolyp.Diet: Diet for NasalPolyp: Avoid aspirin containing foods if sensitive, include vitamin A C, avoid cold which worsens block, 2L warm water, no smoking
NasalPolyp.Exercise: Exercise for NasalPolyp: Breathing exercises, avoid dusty polluted areas, light walk, no swimming if sinusitis active
NasalPolyp.Lab_Tests: For NasalPolyp: Nasal Endoscopy polyp seen grape like, CT PNS polyps, CBC eosinophils, Allergy test, Biopsy if unilateral bleeding

DeviatedSeptum.Description: DeviatedSeptum is crooked displaced nasal septum cartilage bone causing one side nasal block deviation. CAUSES: Birth developmental trauma nose injury
DeviatedSeptum.Symptoms: 1. One side nasal block constant 2. Nosebleeds epistaxis frequent 3. Facial pain headache 4. Noisy breathing snoring 5. Recurrent sinus infection same side 6. Post nasal drip 7. Loss smell mild 8. Dryness crusting in nose 9. Loud breathing sleep 10. Preference to sleep on one side 11. Mouth breathing 12. Pain if spur touching lateral wall
DeviatedSeptum.Precautions: For DeviatedSeptum: Avoid nose injury trauma, no nose picking hard, nasal saline drops for dryness, treat sinus infection early, surgery septoplasty if severe block
DeviatedSeptum.Diet: Diet for DeviatedSeptum: Normal diet, include vitamin C, avoid cold which worsens block, 2L water, no smoking
DeviatedSeptum.Exercise: Exercise for DeviatedSeptum: Can do all exercise, breathing exercises pranayama, avoid contact sports boxing which may worsen deviation
DeviatedSeptum.Lab_Tests: For DeviatedSeptum: Nasal Endoscopy deviated septum seen, CT PNS deviation angle, X-Ray nose if trauma

OtitisMedia.Description: OtitisMedia is middle ear infection inflammation behind eardrum due to bacteria virus cold causing ear pain fever hearing loss. CAUSES: Bacteria Streptococcus pneumoniae Haemophilus after cold allergy eustachian tube block in children
OtitisMedia.Symptoms: 1. Ear pain severe throbbing otalgia 2. Fever 101-102F 3. Hearing loss muffled 4. Ear fullness pressure 5. Pus discharge otorrhea if eardrum rupture 6. Irritability crying in children 7. Loss appetite 8. Headache 9. Dizziness mild 10. Tinnitus ringing 11. Swelling behind ear mastoid if severe 12. Vomiting in children
OtitisMedia.Precautions: For OtitisMedia: Treat cold nasal block early, no ear pricking with pin, keep ear dry, no swimming during infection, complete antibiotic course, no smoking near children, breastfeeding upright
OtitisMedia.Diet: Diet for OtitisMedia: Warm fluids, soft foods, include vitamin C, avoid cold ice cream, 2L water, no oily spicy during fever
OtitisMedia.Exercise: Exercise for OtitisMedia: Rest during fever pain, no swimming diving, no air travel during acute, light walk after fever free
OtitisMedia.Lab_Tests: For OtitisMedia: Otoscopy red bulging eardrum, Tympanometry flat B curve, Audiometry conductive hearing loss, CBC WBC high, Pus culture if discharge

OtitisExterna.Description: OtitisExterna is outer ear canal infection swimmers ear due to bacteria fungus water retention causing pain itching discharge. CAUSES: Bacteria Pseudomonas water swimming ear pricking trauma
OtitisExterna.Symptoms: 1. Ear pain severe worse on pulling pinna tragus tenderness hallmark 2. Itching ear canal intense 3. Red swollen ear canal 4. Discharge watery pus yellow green 5. Hearing loss due to swollen canal blocked 6. Fullness ear 7. Fever mild 8. Swollen lymph nodes around ear 9. Pain on chewing 10. Ringing tinnitus mild 11. Bad smell discharge 12. Bilateral if both ears water exposure
OtitisExterna.Precautions: For OtitisExterna: Keep ear dry no water entry, no ear buds pins, use ear plugs while swimming, dry ear with hair dryer cool after bath, no scratching, ear drops as prescribed
OtitisExterna.Diet: Diet for OtitisExterna: Normal diet, include vitamin C, avoid cold, 2L water, no restriction
OtitisExterna.Exercise: Exercise for OtitisExterna: Avoid swimming until 2 weeks after cure, no water sports, light walk allowed, keep ear dry during exercise sweating wipe
OtitisExterna.Lab_Tests: For OtitisExterna: Otoscopy swollen red canal, Pus culture Pseudomonas, CBC mild high WBC, Audiometry conductive loss if canal blocked

Conjunctivitis.Description: Conjunctivitis is pink eye inflammation of conjunctiva due to virus bacteria allergy causing redness itching discharge highly contagious. CAUSES: Virus adenovirus bacteria staphylococcus allergy dust
Conjunctivitis.Symptoms: 1. Redness pink eye both or one 2. Itching intense 3. Watery or pus discharge sticky eyelids morning 4. Burning foreign body sensation 5. Swelling eyelids 6. Watering tearing 7. Photophobia light sensitivity mild 8. Blurred vision due to discharge 9. Pain mild not severe 10. Swollen preauricular lymph node if viral 11. Contagious spread easily 12. Recurrence if allergy
Conjunctivitis.Precautions: For Conjunctivitis: No touching rubbing eyes, wash hands frequently, no sharing towels handkerchief, isolate from others, no contact lens until cured, cold compress, dark glasses
Conjunctivitis.Diet: Diet for Conjunctivitis: Include vitamin A carrots spinach vitamin C, avoid spicy which increases watering, 2L water, no smoking
Conjunctivitis.Exercise: Exercise for Conjunctivitis: Avoid swimming pool, no eye makeup, rest eyes no mobile long, light walk allowed, no gym if contagious
Conjunctivitis.Lab_Tests: For Conjunctivitis: Clinical diagnosis, Conjunctival swab culture bacteria, Slit lamp exam, Allergy test if recurrent allergic

Glaucoma.Description: Glaucoma is increased intraocular pressure IOP damaging optic nerve causing progressive vision loss blindness due to aqueous humor block. CAUSES: Block of aqueous drainage high IOP family history age steroid use
Glaucoma.Symptoms: 1. No early symptoms silent thief 2. Gradual peripheral vision loss tunnel vision 3. Eye pain headache severe if acute angle closure 4. Redness eye 5. Blurred vision halos around lights rainbow 6. Nausea vomiting if acute high pressure 7. Hard eye on palpation 8. Watering 9. Photophobia 10. Sudden vision loss if acute attack 11. Hazy cornea if acute 12. Pupil fixed mid dilated if acute
Glaucoma.Precautions: For Glaucoma: Regular eye checkup IOP yearly after 40, take eye drops timely never skip, no steroid self without doctor, avoid prolonged head down position, no excessive water intake at once, protect eye injury
Glaucoma.Diet: Diet for Glaucoma: Include green leafy spinach vitamin A C E omega 3, avoid excessive caffeine which raises IOP transient, drink small frequent water not large at once, maintain healthy weight
Glaucoma.Exercise: Exercise for Glaucoma: Regular moderate walk yoga, avoid inverted yoga headstand which raises IOP, no heavy weight lifting straining, avoid tight neck ties
Glaucoma.Lab_Tests: For Glaucoma: Tonometry IOP >21 mmHg high, Optic disc cupping fundoscopy, Visual field test perimetry loss, OCT optic nerve, Gonioscopy angle open closed

Cataract.Description: Cataract is clouding opacity of natural eye lens causing blurred dim vision due to aging protein clumping. CAUSES: Aging diabetes UV sun steroid smoking trauma
Cataract.Symptoms: 1. Blurred cloudy foggy vision like looking through frosted glass 2. Glare halos around lights night driving difficulty 3. Colors faded yellowish 4. Double vision in one eye 5. Frequent change glasses power 6. Need brighter light to read 7. No pain redness early 8. White pupil in advanced mature cataract 9. Poor night vision 10. Hazy vision day 11. No itching 12. Progressive slow months years
Cataract.Precautions: For Cataract: Wear UV sunglasses outdoors, control diabetes sugar, no smoking, no steroid self, regular eye checkup yearly after 50, no eye rubbing trauma, protect eye injury
Cataract.Diet: Diet for Cataract: Include vitamin C citrus A carrots spinach E almonds lutein zeaxanthin green leafy eggs, avoid smoking alcohol, 2L water, maintain healthy weight
Cataract.Exercise: Exercise for Cataract: Regular walk, no restriction before surgery, after surgery avoid bending lifting straining 2 weeks, no eye rubbing, no swimming 1 month post op
Cataract.Lab_Tests: For Cataract: Visual acuity reduced, Slit lamp exam lens opacity grade, Fundoscopy retina check, Biometry IOL power calculation before surgery, Blood sugar HbA1c BP before surgery

HearingLoss.Description: HearingLoss is partial total inability to hear due to conductive sensorineural damage inner ear middle ear nerve. CAUSES: Loud noise age infection otitis media wax trauma ototoxic drugs
HearingLoss.Symptoms: 1. Difficulty hearing soft sounds whispers 2. Need to increase TV volume 3. Asking others to repeat what what 4. Muffled hearing 5. Tinnitus ringing buzzing in ear 6. Ear fullness pressure 7. Dizziness vertigo if inner ear 8. Pain if infection 9. Discharge if infection 10. Loss balance 11. Social withdrawal isolation 12. Delayed speech in children
HearingLoss.Precautions: For HearingLoss: Avoid loud noise DJ headphones >60% volume, no ear buds pins, treat ear infection early, no ototoxic drugs without doctor, use ear protection in noisy work, regular hearing checkup
HearingLoss.Diet: Diet for HearingLoss: Include omega 3 fish magnesium potassium zinc, avoid excessive salt which affects inner ear fluid, 2L water, include vitamin B12 folate
HearingLoss.Exercise: Exercise for HearingLoss: Regular walk improves blood flow to ear, avoid diving pressure changes if eardrum perforation, no head banging loud music during exercise
HearingLoss.Lab_Tests: For HearingLoss: Audiometry pure tone hearing loss degree type, Tympanometry middle ear function, Otoacoustic Emissions OAE, BERA brainstem evoked, CT MRI inner ear if needed

EarInfection.Description: EarInfection is infection of ear outer middle inner due to bacteria virus causing pain fever discharge hearing loss. CAUSES: Bacteria Streptococcus after cold water entry ear pricking
EarInfection.Symptoms: 1. Ear pain severe throbbing 2. Fever 101F 3. Hearing loss muffled 4. Discharge pus yellow green foul smell 5. Itching 6. Fullness pressure 7. Tinnitus ringing 8. Dizziness if inner ear 9. Swelling behind ear 10. Headache 11. Irritability children crying 12. Loss appetite
EarInfection.Precautions: For EarInfection: Keep ear dry, no swimming, no ear buds pins, treat cold early, complete antibiotics, no oil putting if perforation, no smoking near children
EarInfection.Diet: Diet for EarInfection: Warm fluids, avoid cold, include vitamin C, 2L water
EarInfection.Exercise: Exercise for EarInfection: Rest during fever pain, no swimming diving, no air travel during acute, light walk after
EarInfection.Lab_Tests: For EarInfection: Otoscopy red bulging drum or perforation, Pus culture, Audiometry conductive loss, Tympanometry, CBC WBC high

Vertigo.Description: Vertigo is sensation of spinning dizziness due to inner ear vestibular system brain problem causing imbalance. CAUSES: BPPV benign positional inner ear crystals displaced, labyrinthitis vestibular neuritis Meniere disease
Vertigo.Symptoms: 1. Spinning sensation room moving 2. Dizziness on head position change rolling in bed looking up 3. Nausea vomiting due to dizziness 4. Loss balance fall tendency 5. Nystagmus eyes jerking 6. Hearing loss tinnitus if Meniere 7. Sweating 8. Headache 9. Ear fullness pressure 10. Anxiety fear of falling 11. Fatigue after attack 12. No loss consciousness
Vertigo.Precautions: For Vertigo: Avoid sudden head movements, get up slowly from bed, no driving during acute attack, avoid loud noise stress, adequate sleep, treat ear infection, Epley maneuver for BPPV by doctor
Vertigo.Diet: Diet for Vertigo: Low salt <3g if Meniere, avoid caffeine alcohol which worsens, drink 2-3L water, include ginger which helps nausea, avoid smoking
Vertigo.Exercise: Exercise for Vertigo: Vestibular rehabilitation exercises Brandt Daroff Epley as taught by doctor, avoid bending heavy lifting during acute, light walk with support, no heights driving during attack
Vertigo.Lab_Tests: For Vertigo: Dix Hallpike test positive nystagmus in BPPV, Audiometry hearing loss if Meniere, Electronystagmography ENG, MRI brain if central cause, CBC BP check

Gastritis.Description: Gastritis is inflammation of stomach lining due to H pylori NSAID painkillers alcohol spicy causing burning pain. CAUSES: H pylori bacteria NSAID brufen alcohol spicy smoking stress
Gastritis.Symptoms: 1. Burning pain upper abdomen epigastric 2. Pain worse empty stomach night relieved food antacid 3. Nausea vomiting 4. Bloating belching gas 5. Loss appetite 6. Black tarry stools if bleeding 7. Vomiting blood if severe 8. Fullness early satiety 9. Hiccups 10. Weight loss 11. Acid reflux heartburn 12. Fatigue if anemia bleeding
Gastritis.Precautions: For Gastritis: Avoid NSAID painkillers brufen diclofenac without food, no alcohol smoking, avoid spicy oily, eat on time no long fasting, stress control, treat H pylori fully
Gastritis.Diet: Diet for Gastritis: Bland soft diet khichdi curd rice dal roti, avoid spicy oily fried acidic citrus tomato, no tea coffee empty stomach, small frequent meals 5-6, 2-3L water, include banana curd coconut water
Gastritis.Exercise: Exercise for Gastritis: 20-30 min walk after 1 hr meal, avoid heavy exercise empty stomach or immediately after meal, yoga vajrasana after meal helps, avoid lying immediately after meal
Gastritis.Lab_Tests: For Gastritis: Endoscopy upper GI red inflamed stomach erosions, H pylori test urea breath stool antigen biopsy, CBC anemia if bleeding, Stool occult blood, LFT KFT

GERDAcidity.Description: GERD is acid reflux of stomach acid into food pipe esophagus due to LES weak causing heartburn chest burn. CAUSES: LES weak obesity spicy fatty pregnancy tight clothes hiatus hernia
GERDAcidity.Symptoms: 1. Heartburn burning chest after meals lying 2. Acid regurgitation sour bitter mouth 3. Chest pain burning mimics heart 4. Difficulty swallowing dysphagia 5. Chronic cough dry especially night 6. Hoarseness morning 7. Sore throat 8. Bloating belching 9. Nausea 10. Bad breath 11. Hiccups 12. Feeling lump in throat globus
GERDAcidity.Precautions: For GERD: Avoid lying within 2 hrs after meal, elevate head end bed 6 inches, avoid tight belt, control weight, no smoking alcohol, avoid spicy oily fried chocolate mint, small frequent meals
GERDAcidity.Diet: Diet for GERD: Avoid spicy oily fried acidic citrus tomato onion garlic chocolate caffeine tea coffee, include bland soft high fiber oats banana curd, small frequent 5-6 meals, no late night heavy dinner, 2-3L water

IBS.Symptoms: 1. Abdominal pain cramping relieved by passing stool 2. Diarrhea alternating constipation 3. Bloating gas distension 4. Mucus in stool 5. Urgency to pass stool 6. Indigestion.Symptoms: 1. Fullness bloating after meal 2. Burning upper abdomen heartburn 3. Nausea 4. Belching gas 5. Early satiety small amount fills 6. Abdominal pain dull 7. Acid regurgitation sour 8. Loss appetite 9. Vomiting occasional 10. Fatigue 11. Bad breath 12. Constipation or diarrhea

Indigestion.Exercise: Exercise for Indigestion: Walk 10-15 min after meal helps digestion, yoga vajrasana after meal pawanmuktasana, no heavy exercise immediately after meal, regular exercise prevents

Constipation.Description: Constipation is difficult infrequent passage hard stools <3 per week due to low fiber less water inactivity. CAUSES: Low fiber less water inactivity ignoring urge hypothyroid medication iron
Constipation.Symptoms: 1. Hard lumpy stools 2. Straining to pass 3. Infrequent <3 per week 4. Abdominal pain bloating 5. Feeling incomplete evacuation 6. Need manual help finger 7. Nausea loss appetite 8. Headache 9. Anal pain fissure bleeding 10. Hemorrhoids piles due to straining 11. Bad breath coated tongue 12. Fatigue

Diarrhea.Symptoms: 1. Frequent loose watery stools >3 day 2. Urgency cannot hold 3. Abdominal cramps pain 4. Nausea vomiting 5. Fever if infection 6. Blood mucus in stool if dysentery 7. FoodPoisoning.Symptoms: 1. Nausea vomiting sudden after food 2-6 hrs 2. Diarrhea watery frequent 3. Abdominal cramps pain 4. Fever low grade 100-101F 5. Headache 6. Weakness fatigue 7. Dehydration dry mouth thirst 8. Loss appetite 9. Bloating gas 10. Blood in stool if severe 11. Body ache 12. Low BP dizziness if severe dehydration

HemorrhoidsPiles.Description: HemorrhoidsPiles are swollen varicose veins of anus rectum internal external due to straining constipation long sitting. CAUSES: Constipation straining long sitting low fiber pregnancy obesity
HemorrhoidsPiles.Symptoms: 1. Bleeding per rectum bright red during after stool painless 2. Painful lump at anus if thrombosed external 3. Itching around anus 4. Swelling protrusion mass coming out during stool goes inside 5. Pain during after stool if fissure or thrombosed 6. Mucus discharge soiling 7. Incomplete evacuation feeling 8. Discomfort sitting 9. AnalFissure.Symptoms: 1. Severe sharp cutting pain during and after stool lasting hours 2. Bright red bleeding streaks on stool toilet paper 3. Burning pain after stool 4. Itching anus 5. Spasm anal sphincter 6. Fear to pass stool withholding worsens constipation 7. Lump sentinel tag at anus 8. Constipation due to fear 9. Mucus discharge 10. No mass protrusion like piles except sentinel tag

AnalFissure.Lab_Tests: For Fissure: Per rectal visual inspection tear seen, No need scope usually, CBC if bleeding, Rule out piles fistula

AnalFistula.Description: AnalFistula is abnormal tunnel connection between anal canal and skin outside due to previous abscess infection. CAUSES: Previous perianal abscess infection tuberculosis Crohns
AnalFistula.Symptoms: 1. Recurrent pus discharge near anus opening outside with foul smell staining underwear 2. Pain swelling around anus recurrent abscess 3. Itching irritation skin 4. Bleeding occasional 5. Fever during abscess formation 6. Swelling tender lump 7. Recurrence after healing 8. Multiple openings if complex 9. Pain during stool 10. Constipation fear 11. AnalFistula.Lab_Tests: For Fistula: Per rectal exam external opening internal opening, MRI Fistulogram gold standard track, Fistulogram XRay, Pus culture, CBC ESR, TB test, Colonoscopy if Crohns suspected

Hernia.Description: Hernia is protrusion of organ intestine through weak abdominal wall muscle causing bulge pain. CAUSES: Weak abdominal wall heavy lifting chronic cough constipation obesity pregnancy
Hernia.Symptoms: 1. Bulge swelling in groin abdomen navel increases on coughing standing 2. Pain discomfort especially on lifting bending coughing 3. Heaviness dragging feeling 4. Nausea vomiting if obstructed 5. Constipation if bowel stuck 6. Redness tenderness if strangulated emergency 7. Burning groin 8. Difficulty walking 9. No pain if small reducible 10. Increases size over months 11. Gurgling sound if bowel inside 12. Recurrence after surgery if strain
Hernia.Precautions: For Hernia: Avoid heavy lifting >5kg straining, treat chronic cough constipation early, control weight, no tight belts, surgery only permanent cure, wear hernia belt temporarily, stop smoking

Hernia.Lab_Tests: For Hernia: Clinical exam bulge reducible, USG abdomen groin hernia sac bowel, CT abdomen if complex, CBC if obstructed strangulated WBC high

Appendicitis.Description: Acute inflammation of appendix due to fecalith obstruction causing bacterial overgrowth risk rupture peritonitis. CAUSES: Fecalith obstruction lymphoid hyperplasia infection
Appendicitis.Symptoms: 1. Periumbilical pain shifting to RLQ McBurney point 2. Sharp RLQ pain rebound tenderness 3. Low grade fever 100-101F 4. Nausea vomiting after pain starts 5. Loss of appetite 6. Abdominal swelling distension 7. Inability to pass gas 8. Constipation or mild diarrhea 9. Pain worse on coughing walking 10. Muscle guarding rigidity 11. Rapid heart rate 12. Frequent urination
Appendicitis.Precautions: For Appendicitis: No painkillers laxatives heating pad before diagnosis, no eating drinking before surgery, go to ER within 24 hrs, early laparoscopic surgery prevents peritonitis

Appendicitis.Lab_Tests: CBC high WBC >11000 neutrophilia, CRP high, USG appendix >6mm noncompressible, CT Abdomen confirmatory gold standard

Gallstones.Description: Hardened deposits of bile cholesterol bilirubin in gallbladder blocking bile duct causing biliary colic. CAUSES: High cholesterol obesity female hormone estrogen rapid weight loss
Gallstones.Symptoms: 1. Sudden severe RUQ pain biliary colic after fatty meal 2. Pain radiating to right shoulder scapula 3. Nausea vomiting 4. Bloating indigestion after fatty food 5. Low grade fever if infection 6. Jaundice yellow eyes if duct blocked 7. Clay colored stools dark urine 8. Burping gas 9. Fat intolerance 10. Tenderness RUQ Murphy sign 11. Rapid heartbeat 12. Loss appetite

Gallstones.Lab_Tests: USG Abdomen gallstones sludge, LFT bilirubin ALP high, CBC WBC high, MRCP or CT if duct stone

UlcerativeColitis.Symptoms: 1. Bloody diarrhea with mucus pus frequent >4 day 2. Abdominal cramps left lower 3. Urgency cannot hold stool 4. Tenesmus feeling incomplete 5. Weight loss fatigue 6. Perianal fistula abscess pus discharge 8. Blood in stool less than UC 9. Joint pain arthritis 10. Skin rash erythema nodosum 11. Growth failure children 12. Anemia

Delayed puberty

Pancreatitis.Symptoms: 1. Severe upper abdominal pain epigastric radiating to back band like 2. Pain worse after fatty meal lying flat better leaning forward sitting 3. Nausea vomiting persistent 4. Fever 5. Rapid heart rate 6. Abdominal tenderness guarding 7. Bloating distension 8. Loss appetite 9. Weight loss if chronic 10. Oily fatty stools steatorrhea if chronic insufficiency 11. Jaundice if bile duct blocked by swelling 12. Diabetes if chronic endocrine insufficiency

Cholera.Symptoms: 1. Profuse watery diarrhea rice water stools sudden large volume 2. Vomiting frequent 3. Dehydration rapid sunken eyes dry mouth thirst 4. Muscle cramps due to electrolyte loss 5. Asthma.Description: Asthma is chronic airway inflammation reversible obstruction due to allergy causing wheezing breathlessness. CAUSES: Allergy dust pollen smoke genetics
Asthma.Symptoms: 1. Wheezing whistling sound breathing 2. Breathlessness especially night early morning 3. Cough dry especially night 4. Chest tightness pressure 5. Breathlessness on exertion 6. No fever unless infection triggers 7. Symptoms triggered by dust smoke cold 8. Relieved by inhaler 9. Fatigue due night symptoms 10. Anxiety due breathlessness
Asthma.Precautions: For Asthma: Avoid triggers dust smoke cold, use inhaler spacer regular as prescribed never skip, no smoking, regular follow-up spirometry, flu vaccine, keep inhaler always, action plan for attack

Asthma.Lab_Tests: For Asthma: Spirometry reversible obstruction FEV1 increase >12% after bronchodilator, PEFR low, IgE high eosinophils high if allergic, Chest X-Ray usually normal, Allergy test

COPD.Description: COPD is chronic obstructive pulmonary disease due to smoking biomass causing progressive breathlessness. CAUSES: Smoking biomass fuel age
COPD.Symptoms: 1. Chronic cough productive mucus >3 months 2 years 2. Breathlessness progressive exertion 3. Wheezing 4. Chest tightness 5. Fatigue 6. Frequent chest infections 7. Weight loss advanced 8. Swelling legs if cor pulmonale 9. Bluish lips cyanosis advanced 10. Barrel chest advanced
COPD.Precautions: For COPD: Absolute no smoking, avoid biomass smoke dust, take inhalers regular as prescribed, pulmonary rehab breathing exercises, vaccination flu pneumonia yearly, no self medicines, regular follow-up spirometry

COPD.Exercise: Exercise for COPD: Pulmonary rehab walk 30 min daily pursed lip breathing, no heavy exertion during exacerbation, oxygen during exercise if low saturation as doctor
COPD.Lab_Tests: For COPD: Spirometry obstructive FEV1/FVC <0.7 not fully reversible, Chest X-Ray hyperinflated, ABG low oxygen high CO2 advanced, CBC polycythemia high Hb, ECG RVH

Tuberculosis.Description: Tuberculosis is bacterial infection by Mycobacterium tuberculosis lungs mostly causing chronic cough fever weight loss. CAUSES: TB bacteria droplet infection close contact
Tuberculosis.Symptoms: 1. Chronic cough >2 weeks productive 2. Evening low grade fever 99-100F 3. Night sweats 4. Weight loss loss appetite 5. Blood in sputum hemoptysis 6. Chest pain 7. Fatigue 8. Breathlessness if extensive 9. Swelling lymph nodes neck if extrapulmonary 10. No symptoms early
Tuberculosis.Precautions: For TB: Take ATT medicines regular 6-9 months never skip DOTS prevents MDR, isolation first 2 weeks, mask, no smoking alcohol, high protein diet, family screening, sputum disposal covered
Tuberculosis.Diet: Diet for TB: High protein high calorie eggs fish chicken dal milk, include fruits vegetables, 2-3L water, small frequent meals, avoid alcohol smoking

Tuberculosis.Lab_Tests: For TB: Sputum AFB positive ZN stain, CBNAAT GeneXpert positive rifampicin sensitive, Chest X-Ray cavity infiltrate upper lobe, CBC ESR high, Mantoux positive, Sputum culture gold, KFT LFT before ATT

Pneumonia.Description: Pneumonia is infection inflammation alveoli lungs due to bacteria virus causing fever cough breathlessness. CAUSES: Bacteria Streptococcus pneumoniae virus flu aspiration
Pneumonia.Symptoms: 1. High fever 102-104F with chills 2. Cough productive yellow green rusty sputum 3. Chest pain pleuritic worse breathing 4. Breathlessness rapid breathing 5. Fatigue 6. Sweating 7. Nausea vomiting 8. Confusion elderly 9. Bluish lips if severe low oxygen 10. No appetite
Pneumonia.Precautions: For Pneumonia: Take antibiotics full course as prescribed, no smoking alcohol, rest, plenty fluids, vaccination pneumococcal flu, maintain hygiene, treat cold early
Pneumonia.Diet: Diet for Pneumonia: High protein high calorie small frequent meals if breathless, include fruits vegetables, 3L water coconut water soups, avoid cold, include turmeric
Pneumonia.Exercise: Exercise for Pneumonia: Complete bed rest during high fever breathlessness, no exertion until 1 week after fever, light walk after, breathing exercises after recovery, no smoking
Pneumonia.Lab_Tests: For Pneumonia: Chest X-Ray lobar infiltrate consolidation, CBC WBC high neutrophils, CRP high, Sputum culture bacteria, Blood culture if severe, ABG low oxygen, Pulse oximetry low

Bronchitis.Description: Bronchitis is inflammation bronchi airways due to virus smoking causing cough mucus. CAUSES: Virus flu smoking air pollution
Bronchitis.Symptoms: 1. Cough productive mucus white yellow 2. Low fever 100-101F 3. Chest discomfort tightness 4. Fatigue 5. Breathlessness mild 6. Wheezing mild 7. Sore throat if viral 8. Body ache 9. No high fever like pneumonia 10. Recurrence if smoker
Bronchitis.Precautions: For Bronchitis: No smoking, avoid cold dust smoke, steam inhalation, plenty fluids, take medicines as prescribed, rest, vaccination flu
Bronchitis.Diet: Diet for Bronchitis: Warm fluids turmeric milk honey ginger tea soups, avoid cold ice cream smoking, include fruits vegetables vitamin C, 2-3L water
Bronchitis.Exercise: Exercise for Bronchitis: Rest during fever cough, no heavy exertion until cough better, light walk after 1 week, breathing exercises
Bronchitis.Lab_Tests: For Bronchitis: Clinical diagnosis, Chest X-Ray normal or increased bronchial markings, CBC WBC mild high if bacterial, Spirometry normal, Sputum culture if purulent recurrent

SleepApnea.Description: SleepApnea is repeated pauses breathing during sleep due to airway collapse obesity causing snoring day sleepiness. CAUSES: Obesity large neck airway obstruction
SleepApnea.Symptoms: 1. Loud snoring 2. Pauses breathing witnessed by partner apnea 3. Gasping choking at night 4. Daytime sleepiness fatigue 5. Morning headache 6. Irritability mood changes 7. High BP difficult control 8. Nocturia night urination 9. Dry mouth morning 10. Difficulty concentration
SleepApnea.Precautions: For Sleep Apnea: Weight loss 10% if obese main treatment, no alcohol sedatives before sleep, side sleeping not back, CPAP machine regular use if prescribed, no smoking, treat nasal block
SleepApnea.Diet: Diet for Sleep Apnea: Low calorie weight loss diet, avoid alcohol evening, avoid heavy meal before sleep, include fruits vegetables whole grains, 2L water, small frequent meals
SleepApnea.Exercise: Exercise for Sleep Apnea: Regular 45 min walk daily weight loss improves apnea, no heavy before sleep, yoga breathing
SleepApnea.Lab_Tests: For Sleep Apnea: Sleep study polysomnography gold AHI >5 mild >15 moderate >30 severe, BMI high neck >17 inch male >16 female, ECG high BP, Thyroid TSH hypothyroid cause

Migraine.Description: Migraine is recurrent severe headache one side pulsating due to neurovascular dysfunction trigeminal. CAUSES: Genetic trigger stress lack sleep cheese chocolate alcohol periods
Migraine.Symptoms: 1. Severe throbbing headache one side 2. Nausea vomiting 3. Photophobia phonophobia light sound sensitivity 4. Aura flashing lights zigzag before headache some 5. Worsens with activity 6. Duration 4-72 hrs 7. Recurrence monthly 8. No fever 9. Fatigue after attack 10. Tingling face hand if aura
Migraine.Precautions: For Migraine: Avoid triggers lack sleep stress cheese chocolate alcohol strong smell, regular sleep meals, no fasting, dark quiet room during attack, medicines triptan prophylaxis as prescribed regular, diary trigger

Migraine.Lab_Tests: For Migraine: Clinical diagnosis history, No scan needed usually, MRI Brain if atypical red flags, Eye check

TensionHeadache.Description: TensionHeadache is common headache band like pressure both sides due to muscle tension stress. CAUSES: Stress anxiety poor posture lack sleep
TensionHeadache.Symptoms: 1. Band like pressure both sides head 2. Dull aching not throbbing 3. No nausea vomiting severe like migraine 4. No aura 5. Mild photophobia not severe 6. Worse evening stress 7. Neck muscle tightness 8. Duration 30 min to 7 days 9. Not worsened by activity 10. Recurrent
TensionHeadache.Precautions: For Tension Headache: Stress management relaxation, regular sleep 7 hrs, posture correction computer, no long screen time, regular exercise walk yoga, no self painkiller excess causes rebound
TensionHeadache.Diet: Diet for Tension Headache: Regular meals no skipping, avoid excessive caffeine, include magnesium, 2L water, no alcohol
TensionHeadache.Exercise: Exercise for Tension Headache: Regular walk yoga stretching neck, no heavy during headache rest, posture exercises
TensionHeadache.Lab_Tests: For Tension Headache: Clinical, No tests needed, Rule out migraine

Stroke.Description: Stroke is brain attack due to clot bleeding blocking blood flow to brain causing paralysis speech loss. CAUSES: Clot atherosclerosis high BP AF diabetes smoking
Stroke.Symptoms: 1. Sudden weakness one side face arm leg FAST 2. Face droop one side 3. Arm drift cannot raise 4. Speech slurred aphasia 5. Sudden severe headache worst ever if bleeding 6. Dizziness loss balance 7. Vision loss one side double 8. Confusion 9. No pain usually ischemic painful if hemorrhagic headache
Stroke.Precautions: For Stroke: Emergency hospital within 4.5 hrs golden window clot buster, control BP sugar cholesterol, no smoking alcohol, take antiplatelet statin regular, physiotherapy speech therapy early, fall prevention
Stroke.Diet: Diet for Stroke: Low salt low fat <3g salt, include fruits vegetables whole grains olive oil, 2L water thickened if dysphagia as speech therapist advises, small frequent meals, no alcohol smoking
Stroke.Exercise: Exercise for Stroke: Physiotherapy daily early mobilization, speech therapy, no heavy, rest during acute, walk with support after stable
Stroke.Lab_Tests: For Stroke: CT Brain within 1 hr bleed vs clot, MRI Brain DWI infarct, Carotid Doppler plaque, ECG AF, 2D Echo clot source, Blood sugar HbA1c lipid, PT INR

TransientIschemicAttack.Description: TransientIschemicAttack is mini stroke temporary block brain blood flow <24 hrs warning for stroke. CAUSES: Clot atherosclerosis AF high BP
TransientIschemicAttack.Symptoms: 1. Sudden weakness one side face arm leg <24 hrs resolves 2. Face droop transient 3. Speech slurred temporary 4. Vision loss transient one eye amaurosis 5. Dizziness 6. No headache usually 7. Resolves within minutes hours 8. No permanent damage but high stroke risk next 48 hrs 9. Tingling one side
TransientIschemicAttack.Precautions: For TIA: Emergency hospital same as stroke within hours, control BP sugar cholesterol, no smoking alcohol, take antiplatelet statin regular, carotid Doppler, ECG AF check, lifestyle change
TransientIschemicAttack.Diet: Diet for TIA: Low salt <3g low fat <30g, include fruits vegetables whole grains olive oil nuts, 2-3L water, no alcohol smoking
TransientIschemicAttack.Exercise: Exercise for TIA: Regular 30 min walk after doctor clearance, no heavy until evaluated, physiotherapy if weakness persists
TransientIschemicAttack.Lab_Tests: For TIA: CT MRI brain may be normal or small infarct DWI, Carotid Doppler stenosis, ECG Holter AF, 2D Echo, Blood sugar HbA1c lipid, PT INR

PeripheralNeuropathy.Description: PeripheralNeuropathy is damage peripheral nerves hands feet due to diabetes B12 deficiency causing tingling numbness. CAUSES: Diabetes B12 deficiency alcohol chemo
PeripheralNeuropathy.Symptoms: 1. Tingling numbness hands feet glove stocking 2. Burning pain especially night 3. Weakness grip foot drop 4. Loss balance 5. Sensitivity to touch allodynia 6. Muscle cramps 7. No sweating dry skin 8. Constipation bladder issues if autonomic 9. Wounds feet unnoticed 10. Slow healing
PeripheralNeuropathy.Precautions: For Neuropathy: Control sugar B12, no alcohol, foot care daily check, wear soft shoes, no barefoot, treat cause diabetes B12, medicines gabapentin as prescribed, avoid injury

PeripheralNeuropathy.Lab_Tests: For Neuropathy: Nerve Conduction Study NCV slowed, EMG, Blood sugar HbA1c diabetes, B12 low, KFT thyroid, CBC, Urine microalbumin

Sciatica.Description: Sciatica is pain radiating leg due to sciatic nerve compression slip disc piriformis causing leg pain. CAUSES: Slip disc L4 L5 S1 piriformis tight obesity
Sciatica.Symptoms: 1. Pain radiating buttock back of thigh calf foot one side 2. Burning shooting electric pain 3. Numbness tingling leg foot 4. Weakness leg foot 5. Pain worse sitting coughing bending 6. Better lying 7. Low back pain may be present 8. Difficulty walking standing long 9. No fever unless infection
Sciatica.Precautions: For Sciatica: No heavy lifting bending twisting, no long sitting driving, posture correction, physiotherapy McKenzie, hot cold fomentation, weight loss, ergonomic chair, no bed rest >2 days active

Sciatica.Lab_Tests: For Sciatica: Straight Leg Raise SLR positive, MRI Lumbar spine disc prolapse nerve compression gold, X-Ray LS spine, Nerve conduction if needed, Vitamin D B12

CervicalSpondylosis.Symptoms: 1. Neck pain stiffness especially morning 2. Pain radiating shoulder arm hand 3. Numbness tingling arm hand 4. Headache back of head 5. Dizziness vertigo 6. Stiffness neck reduced movement 7. Weakness grip 8. Clicking sound neck movement 9. Pain worse long computer driving 10. No fever

HerpesZosterShingles.Symptoms: 1. Painful burning tingling one side dermatome before rash 2. Grouped vesicles blisters on red base one side not crossing midline 3. Fever low grade 4. Mumps.Symptoms: 1. Swelling parotid one or both sides angle jaw 2. Pain swallowing chewing 3. Fever 101-102F 4. Headache 5. Fatigue 6. Loss appetite 7. Painful testis orchitis male post puberty 8. Abdominal pain pancreatitis

InfluenzaFlu.Symptoms: 1. Sudden high fever 102-104F 2. Severe bodyache muscle pain 3. Headache 4. Dry cough sore throat 5. Runny nose 6. Fatigue severe 7. Nausea vomiting diarrhea sometimes 8. No rash
